limitations: Per-instance admission, owned parent jobs and captured-output limits; no hard CPU/GPU/RAM/disk-write quota or cross-host coordination.
Real local processes, SDK clients and filesystem success/denial. Unsupported/permission/invalid-statistics and post-spawn errors are controlled negative injections, not proof of untested OS support.
Disk observations are advisory. A conservative reservation pool and owned-completion epoch reject declared overcommit/stale observations; no hostile-writer or kernel-level filesystem isolation.
Native cancellation/deadlines are cooperative and retain physical pending I/O until settlement. No actual ChatGPT app integration or external model request.
Full AUG012 capability acceptance remains false;12 existing Windows-only suite skips on non-Windows do not skip any new resource scenario.

caseEvidence.success: real filesystem capacity admits a declared job and above-total floor denies before spawn without deleting data; two real SDK hosts expose independent immutable budgets and installed native disk admission
caseEvidence.permission_denied: placement rejects outside, private, linked and non-directory candidates before probing them; explicit per-job ceiling denial; injected EACCES backend denial is labeled separately
caseEvidence.cancelled: cancelled statfs retains its physical pending slot until settlement and cannot spawn late; actual MCP cancellation during delayed real statfs cannot launch a native child after client abort
caseEvidence.deadline: cooperative admission deadline after real statfs fails closed with no late child, with an asserted completed probe
caseEvidence.unsupported_platform: injected ENOSYS/ENOTSUP failures are distinct and fail closed; this is unsupported-backend behavior on a real supported host, not acceptance of any untested operating system
